name: Space weather
summary: NOAA scales at G0 S0 R0 in the 24 hours to 16 Nov; forecast peaks at a minor G1 storm
state: NOAA's space weather scales showed no geomagnetic storm, solar radiation storm or radio blackout in the 24 hours to 05:39 UTC on 16 Nov, and its forecast peaks at a minor G1 geomagnetic storm, inside the Normal band (NOAA SWPC).
for_you: No effect expected on power grids, GPS or radio; aurora may be visible in the far north.
why: Severe solar storms can disrupt satellites, GPS, HF radio and power grids.
drivers: Solar flares and coronal mass ejections; solar cycle 25 is near its peak.
